name: old asphalt road of warm charcoal grey with broad soft worn mottling that flows across tiles (four grey steps joined by fine dither), a few isolated light aggregate pixels and a few thin dirt-filled cracks that wander across tile borders; its unconnected edges are a continuous gently wavy broken rim into dirt with occasional wider bites, rounded at corners and dead ends, and a dry dark-brown ledge on the south side; laid as a road network with crossroads, dead ends and long straight 1-wide and 3-wide runs
